title: Time-series trend on NIFTY and BANKNIFTY futures
hypothesis: Holding NIFTY or BANKNIFTY near-month futures only while the trailing trend signal is positive (and short when negative, in the long-short variant) gives a higher Sharpe ratio and a smaller drawdown than buy and hold, after charges and rolls.

mechanism.text: Under-reaction then over-reaction to information, and hedging demand; trend pays most in long bad markets.

evidence.source: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, Journal of Financial Economics 104(2)
evidence.finding: The past 12-month return predicts the next month; partial reversal after a year.

evidence.source: Hurst, Ooi and Pedersen, Journal of Portfolio Management 44(1)
evidence.finding: Trend following positive in every decade, strongest across many markets.

evidence.source: Trend following algorithms on NIFTY closes, Indian Journal of Finance
evidence.finding: 80 trend rules on NIFTY: mixed results across rising, falling and trendless periods.

universe.name: nifty-banknifty-futures
universe.rule: Near-month futures, rolled at the close 3 sessions before expiry; notional equal to capital.

turnover.basis: about 8 flips and 12 rolls a year x 0.080% futures round trip, on notional

needs: continuous series with a roll log

prior_trials.basis: No futures trend rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net Sharpe above buy and hold's and the holdout drawdown at most 0.8 times buy and hold's.

kill_criteria: Holdout Sharpe at or below buy and hold's.
Holdout drawdown more than 0.8 times buy and hold's.
The long-short variant's short side losing money in validation (then only long-flat may continue, as a new id).

prior.reason: Trend's Sharpe comes from diversification across many markets; one rising index gives a weak signal.

feasibility.reason: Index and futures history exist back to 2005 in legacy bhavcopies; needs #71 continuous futures and #72 futures engine.

contamination: trader-regime and the lab's regime split read NIFTY 50 closes for 2024 to 2026; no calendar or trend rule on index futures has been run in this repo. The holdout overlaps those sessions.
